package domain

import "testing"

func TestNormalizeGoalGraphAllowsMultipleTargetsInOneLesson(t *testing.T) {
	graph := minimalGraph()
	second := graph.Targets[0]
	second.Ref = TargetRef{Type: TargetCapability, Key: "go.second", Version: "v1"}
	second.Title = "Second"
	graph.Targets = append(graph.Targets, second)
	if _, err := NormalizeGoalGraph(graph); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("multiple targets in one lesson must be valid: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestNormalizeGoalGraphRejectsConflictingLessonPlacement(t *testing.T) {
	graph := minimalGraph()
	second := graph.Targets[0]
	second.Ref = TargetRef{Type: TargetCapability, Key: "go.second", Version: "v1"}
	second.Title = "Second"
	second.LessonTitle = "Conflicting title"
	graph.Targets = append(graph.Targets, second)
	if _, err := NormalizeGoalGraph(graph); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected conflicting placement to fail")
	}
}

func TestNormalizeGoalGraphRejectsCorruptTopologyAndTransition(t *testing.T) {
	secondTarget := func() LearningTarget {
		return LearningTarget{
			Ref: TargetRef{Type: TargetCapability, Key: "programming.second", Version: "v1"}, Title: "Second",
			ModuleCode: "module", ModuleTitle: "Module", ModuleOrder: 0,
			SectionCode: "section-two", SectionTitle: "Section two", SectionOrder: 1,
			LessonCode: "lesson-two", LessonTitle: "Lesson two", LessonOrder: 0,
		}
	}
	tests := []struct {
		name   string
		mutate func(*GoalGraph)
	}{
		{name: "external prerequisite", mutate: func(graph *GoalGraph) {
			graph.Targets[0].Prerequisites = []TargetRef{{Type: TargetConcept, Key: "external.target", Version: "v1"}}
		}},
		{name: "self edge", mutate: func(graph *GoalGraph) {
			graph.Targets[0].Prerequisites = []TargetRef{graph.Targets[0].Ref}
		}},
		{name: "cycle", mutate: func(graph *GoalGraph) {
			second := secondTarget()
			second.Prerequisites = []TargetRef{graph.Targets[0].Ref}
			graph.Targets[0].Prerequisites = []TargetRef{second.Ref}
			graph.Targets = append(graph.Targets, second)
		}},
		{name: "external transition", mutate: func(graph *GoalGraph) {
			graph.Transitions = []TransitionKnowledge{{
				SourceStack: "go", Target: TargetRef{Type: TargetConcept, Key: "external.target", Version: "v1"},
				Similarity: "similar", Difference: "different", AnalogyBoundary: "bounded",
			}}
		}},
	}
	for _, testCase := range tests {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			graph := minimalGraph()
			testCase.mutate(&graph)
			if _, err := NormalizeGoalGraph(graph); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("expected corrupt graph to fail closed")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestOrderGoalTargetsIsDeterministic(t *testing.T) {
	graph := minimalGraph()
	second := LearningTarget{
		Ref: TargetRef{Type: TargetCapability, Key: "programming.second", Version: "v1"}, Title: "Second",
		Prerequisites: []TargetRef{graph.Targets[0].Ref},
		ModuleCode:    "module", ModuleTitle: "Module", ModuleOrder: 0,
		SectionCode: "section-two", SectionTitle: "Section two", SectionOrder: 1,
		LessonCode: "lesson-two", LessonTitle: "Lesson two", LessonOrder: 0,
	}
	graph.Targets = append([]LearningTarget{second}, graph.Targets...)
	normalized, err := NormalizeGoalGraph(graph)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("normalize: %v", err)
	}
	ordered, err := OrderGoalTargets(normalized.Targets)
	if err != nil || len(ordered) != 2 || ordered[0].Ref != graph.Targets[1].Ref || ordered[1].Ref != second.Ref {
		t.Fatalf("ordered=%#v err=%v", ordered, err)
	}
}

func minimalGraph() GoalGraph {
	return GoalGraph{
		Goal: LearningGoal{Code: "go.backend", Version: "v1", GraphVersion: "graph-v1", Title: "Go Backend"},
		Targets: []LearningTarget{
			{
				Ref: TargetRef{Type: TargetConcept, Key: "go.first", Version: "v1"}, Title: "First",
				ModuleCode: "module", ModuleTitle: "Module", ModuleOrder: 0,
				SectionCode: "section", SectionTitle: "Section", SectionOrder: 0,
				LessonCode: "lesson", LessonTitle: "Lesson", LessonOrder: 0,
			},
		},
	}
}
